description: This file is a Python module for managing MKL-DNN (oneDNN) backend support in PyTorch, including functions to check availability, set verbose logging, configure flags, and define a module class for MKL-DNN features.

classes.name: verbose
classes.description: Class providing on-demand verbose logging control for oneDNN (MKL-DNN) in PyTorch.

classes.name: MkldnnModule
classes.description: Class representing a module for MKL-DNN support with methods to check availability and context properties.

methods.name: is_available
methods.description: Checks if MKL-DNN support is available in the current PyTorch build.

methods.name: is_acl_available
methods.description: Checks if MKL-DNN with ACL support is available.

methods.name: verbose.__init__
methods.description: Initializes verbose level for on-demand verbose logging.

methods.name: verbose.__enter__
methods.description: Enables verbose mode based on the set level.

methods.name: set_flags
methods.description: Sets various MKL-DNN related flags such as enabled, deterministic, allow_tf32, and fp32_precision.

methods.name: flags
methods.description: Context manager to temporarily set MKL-DNN flags.

methods.name: MkldnnModule.is_available
methods.description: Method to check if MKL-DNN is available.
